cs.t: I'm a note taker and I got tired of having hand written notes scattered all over and never being able to find the note I needed.  So took a leap and purchased an iPad Air and an Apple Pencil 2. I carry it with me and make all my notes there. I use it way more than I ever imagined.  I use the Paperlike screen protector to make it feel more like writing on a notebook.  And it has all the added benefits of an iPad.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are some interesting/useful things that you purchased this year?
